I'M OBSESSED WITH YOU
Kevin I think I'm obsessed with you.
transcript: Kevin I think I'm obsessed with you. Is that bad? I think so. Why? I'm so dependent on you. I just want to exist around you. Why is that bad? Sometimes I want to be inside your skin and involve you in everything I do. Sometimes I even want to bite you. I don't think this is normal. Am I weird? I think it's really cute. I even eat the drumsticks part of the wings even though I hate them. I do it cuz you like doing that twisty bone thing. You always look so proud. You better marry me. Otherwise there will be a Netflix documentary about us.
